items.title: investingLive Americas FX news wrap 13 Oct: Dollar retreats as traders await CPI; oil rises and stocks slip
items.summary: Tomorrow’s U.S. CPI report is the next big test for the markets. Will inflation remain concentrated in energy, or will the data show price pressures spreading more broadly? That question took on added importance after Susan Collins, president of the Boston Fed, reiterated her support for another rate hike before year-end. Tuesday’s market moves were mixed.
